technology_name: NIR Photovoltaic Power Delivery for Implantable Devices
model: uncertainty -> experiment -> information gained -> technical decision -> capital avoided/unlocked (directive section 17)
dominant_uncertainty: Whether the recorded optical-to-electrical power chain survives a physical tissue-equivalent path at thermally safe source power — currently the entire quantitative chain is simulation-ASSERTED with execution artifacts absent, and the recorded numbers contain two unreconciled arithmetic discrepancies (ENERGY_BUDGET D1/D2).

uncertainty_inventory.uncertainty: Does the 1.0-1.4 mW/cm² fluence survive a real tissue-equivalent path?
uncertainty_inventory.class: REALITY_CHECK on the package's central asserted quantity
uncertainty_inventory.resolvable_by: The phantom-path decisive experiment (reference photodiode measures delivered fluence directly)
uncertainty_inventory.information_gained_if_run: The asserted chain becomes physically measured or physically refuted — either way the package's first reality-anchored number
uncertainty_inventory.decision_it_changes: Whether ANY power-delivery claim in this package can be made to a buyer at all
uncertainty_inventory.capital_at_stake: The package cannot rationally attract sponsorship while its central quantity is non-reproducible from the repository; the experiment is the cheapest exit from that state

uncertainty_inventory.uncertainty: Low-irradiance GaAs efficiency (~30 % class at ~1 mW/cm²?)
uncertainty_inventory.current_state: UNKNOWN (targeted cell untested at low irradiance)
uncertainty_inventory.information_gained_if_run: Effective efficiency at implanted irradiance — closes the module-vs-system conflation permanently
uncertainty_inventory.decision_it_changes: Whether the 100-160 uW class output is real; feeds the D2 target/area decision

uncertainty_inventory.uncertainty: Thermal envelope at required source power
uncertainty_inventory.current_state: UNKNOWN (heating limit basis unrecorded; source power UNKNOWN)
uncertainty_inventory.resolvable_by: Pre-registered thermal limits + the experiment's thermal endpoints
uncertainty_inventory.information_gained_if_run: The kill-or-survive answer on thermal infeasibility — a genuine falsifier, not a design detail
uncertainty_inventory.decision_it_changes: A negative thermal result kills the concept at the cheapest possible point, before any implant development

uncertainty_inventory.uncertainty: D1/D2 arithmetic discrepancies (claimed power not reproducible; target vs area gap)
uncertainty_inventory.resolvable_by: Owner action: record the inputs behind ~1050 uW or withdraw it; decide target vs area
uncertainty_inventory.information_gained_if_resolved: A defensible pre-registered acceptance band for the experiment
uncertainty_inventory.decision_it_changes: Whether the experiment's primary endpoint is decidable

cheapest_decisive_action: The bench phantom-path experiment (DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT.json) — no human/animal subjects, standard bench components, one receiver sample; it simultaneously reality-checks fluence, efficiency, and thermal feasibility. Resolving D1/D2 is a PREREQUISITE (owner action, near-zero cost).
what_a_buyer_buys_by_funding_it: Conversion of the package's entire quantitative basis from simulation-asserted to physically measured — including a genuine chance of a clean kill (thermal or fluence failure) that saves the entire implant-development chain. For a platform-adjacent technology, that single measurement triplet (fluence, efficiency, temperature) is the gate on every downstream application claim.
explicit_not_claimed: No monetary VOI figure — requires owner cost inputs; inventing one would violate Constitution Art. XXVII/VI
next_information_gain_order: 1. Resolve D1/D2 + restore/re-run the registered simulation chain (prerequisite, owner-gated)
2. The phantom-path decisive experiment (kills or anchors the power chain)
3. Encapsulation transmission measurement (only after the chain survives)
4. Implant-integrated receiver prototype (only after 2-3 both positive)
